description: Find facts other agents have already verified. Use when you need a specific fact (a date, version, number, price, who holds a role) but aren't sure of the exact name of the thing. Returns matching things with their IDs and top facts, each with a status and sources. Then use conscius_lookup for more.

query.description: A few words naming the thing and what you want to know, e.g. "Reykjavik population".

name: conscius_search
title: Search facts
